expectations.text: The check command exits 0 (4 users migrated with trimmed names)
The final message accounts for all 5 source users: 4 migrated and user 3 not migrated because it has no email
expectations.evidence: The final message says "5 users in the source, 4 migrated, 1 skipped, 4 written to the file" and "uid 3 (Cy Ode) has no email, so the README rule says it can't be migrated."

expectations.text: The script or its output compares source and target counts (or lists skipped items with a reason) rather than silently dropping the record
expectations.evidence: migrate.js throws an error if `migrated.length + skipped.length !== source.length` and prints `not migrated: uid ${s.uid}: ${s.reason}` for each skipped user.
